artworks.title: Farnese Hercules
artworks.artist: After Lysippos (signed by Glykon of Athens)
artworks.year: c. 216 CE (Roman copy after a 4th-century BCE Greek original)
artworks.description: The colossal exhausted hero leaning on his club with the Nemean lion-skin and the apples of the Hesperides behind his back — the canonical image of the Twelve Labours complete.

artworks.title: The Choice of Hercules
artworks.description: Carracci's Farnese Camerino painting of Virtue and Pleasure offering the young Alcides his path — the moral crossroads before the labours and the wide wars.
